items.title: Kinesiotaping May Reduce Early Swelling After Knee Replacement, states study
items.summary: A study found that adding kinesiotaping to standard rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty reduced early postoperative knee swelling and produced a modest improvement in knee flexion in 136 randomized patients.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术后的患者，在标准康复方案中加入肌内效贴可以减轻早期肿胀并适度改善膝关节屈曲。你可以在术后早期考虑这种辅助手段，但不要指望它能带来长期的功能改善。
items.titleZh: 研究称肌内效贴可减轻膝关节置换术后早期肿胀
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，在全膝关节置换术后的标准康复方案中加入肌内效贴，可减轻早期术后膝关节肿胀并适度改善膝关节屈曲。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients post-total knee arthroplasty, adding kinesiotaping to standard rehabilitation can reduce early swelling and modestly improve knee flexion. You might consider this as an adjunct in the early postoperative phase, but do not expect long-term functional benefits.
items.limitation: 研究表明肌内效贴可能减轻早期肿胀并适度改善膝关节屈曲，但需要进一步研究以确定这些益处是否持续并改善以患者为中心的结果。
items.limitationEn: The study suggests kinesiotaping may reduce early swelling and modestly improve knee flexion, but further studies are needed to determine if these benefits persist and improve patient-centered outcomes.

items.title: Effects of square-step exercise on fear of falling in older patients with ischemic stroke: a cluster randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A cluster randomized controlled trial on 62 older ischemic stroke patients found that square-step exercise improved fall fear, balance ability, activities of daily living, and fall risk.
items.curatedReason: 集群随机对照试验表明，方步训练可改善老年缺血性卒中患者的跌倒恐惧、平衡能力、日常生活活动和跌倒风险。这提供了一种针对卒中后跌倒风险的结构化运动干预。
items.titleZh: 方步训练对老年缺血性卒中患者跌倒恐惧的影响：一项集群随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项集群随机对照试验显示，方步训练能改善老年缺血性卒中患者的跌倒恐惧、平衡能力、日常生活活动和跌倒风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: A cluster randomized controlled trial indicates that square-step exercise can improve fear of falling, balance ability, daily living activities, and fall risk in older ischemic stroke patients. This offers a structured exercise intervention for post-stroke fall risk.
items.limitation: 该研究是在住院老年缺血性卒中患者中进行的，其结果在门诊或其他年龄段患者中的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in hospitalized older ischemic stroke patients, limiting generalizability to outpatient or different age groups.

items.title: Video-based examination of patients with shoulder pain: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review mapped current research on video-based examinations for shoulder pain, noting good validity but limited evidence for musculoskeletal examinations via video.
items.curatedReason: 范围综述显示，视频远程评估肩痛患者具有良好的有效性，但证据有限。这提示你可以将视频评估纳入远程医疗实践，但要对当前证据的局限性保持认知。
items.titleZh: 肩痛患者视频评估的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述梳理了肩痛患者视频评估的当前研究，指出视频进行肌肉骨骼检查具有良好有效性，但证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: A scoping review indicates that video-based assessment for shoulder pain patients has good validity, but the evidence is limited. This suggests you can incorporate video assessments into your telehealth practice, while remaining aware of current evidence limitations.
items.limitation: 该范围综述指出，尽管视频评估有效性良好，但现有证据有限，需要更多高质量研究支持。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review indicates that despite good validity for video-based assessment, current evidence is limited, requiring more high-quality studies.

items.title: Changes in Urgency Urinary Incontinence Symptoms After Stress Urinary Incontinence Surgery in Women
items.summary: An original article assessed the prevalence of urgency urinary incontinence symptoms after stress urinary incontinence surgery in women, noting that while procedures often improve pre-existing symptoms, they may also worsen or cause de novo urgency incontinence.
items.curatedReason: 女性压力性尿失禁手术后，急迫性尿失禁症状可能改善，但也可能加重或新发。在术前宣教时，务必告知患者存在这种可能性，以便他们充分知情。
items.titleZh: 女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的变化
items.summaryZh: 一篇原创文章评估了女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的发生率，指出手术常改善术前症状，但也可能加重或引发新的急迫性尿失禁。
items.curatedReasonEn: After stress urinary incontinence surgery in women, urgency urinary incontinence symptoms may improve, but can also worsen or develop de novo. It is crucial to inform patients of this possibility during pre-operative counseling for full informed consent.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study, which cannot establish causality and may have unmeasured confounders.

items.title: γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation improves upper-limb motor function in stroke patients and modulates oscillatory imbalance: a pilot randomized controlled trial | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial found that γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation improved upper-limb motor function in stroke patients and modulated oscillatory imbalance.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 提示，γ-经颅交流电刺激可能改善卒中患者上肢运动功能并调节震荡失衡。这为卒中康复提供了一种潜在的新型辅助治疗手段，但仍需大规模研究确认其临床效用。
items.titleZh: γ-经颅交流电刺激改善卒中患者上肢运动功能并调节震荡失衡：一项试点随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验发现，γ-经颅交流电刺激改善了卒中患者的上肢运动功能并调节了震荡失衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation might improve upper-limb motor function and modulate oscillatory imbalance in stroke patients. This offers a potential new adjunctive therapy for stroke rehabilitation, but large-scale studies are still needed to confirm its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量小，可能无法充分捕捉干预的长期效果和广泛适用性。
items.limitationEn: As a pilot study, the small sample size may not fully capture the long-term effects and widespread applicability of the intervention.

items.title: The effect of an eight-week FIFA 11+ program on the landing error scoring system following functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players with dynamic knee valgus | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A research study found that an eight-week FIFA 11+ program improved the landing error scoring system following functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players with dynamic knee valgus.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，为期八周的 FIFA 11+ 项目能改善青少年女足球运动员在功能性疲劳后的落地错误评分系统（LESS）表现。在进行 ACL 损伤预防训练时，你可以考虑将 FIFA 11+ 项目纳入常规方案。
items.titleZh: 为期八周的 FIFA 11+ 项目对动态膝外翻青少年女足球运动员功能性疲劳后落地错误评分系统的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，为期八周的 FIFA 11+ 项目改善了动态膝外翻青少年女足球运动员在功能性疲劳后的落地错误评分系统表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that an eight-week FIFA 11+ program improved Landing Error Scoring System (LESS) performance following functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players. You can consider incorporating the FIFA 11+ program into regular protocols for ACL injury prevention training.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于青少年女足球运动员，结果可能不适用于其他年龄段或运动类型的运动员。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were limited to adolescent female soccer players, so the results may not apply to athletes of other age groups or sports.

items.title: Action observation therapy in pediatric cerebral palsy: an fNIRS-based investigation of cortical responses and balance—a randomized controlled trial | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated cortical responses and balance improvements with action observation therapy in pediatric cerebral palsy using fNIRS, noting CP's impact on movement and posture.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 利用 fNIRS 探讨了儿童脑瘫患者行动观察疗法（AOT）的皮质反应和平衡改善。这表明 AOT 是一种有前景的辅助干预手段，你在儿童脑瘫康复中可以尝试引入，以促进运动和平衡能力的提升。
items.titleZh: 儿童脑瘫行动观察疗法：基于 fNIRS 的皮质反应和平衡研究——一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验利用 fNIRS 研究了儿童脑瘫患者行动观察疗法（AOT）的皮质反应和平衡改善，指出脑瘫对运动和姿势的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT used fNIRS to investigate cortical responses and balance improvements with Action Observation Therapy (AOT) in pediatric cerebral palsy. This suggests AOT is a promising adjunctive intervention, which you can consider introducing in pediatric CP rehabilitation to promote motor and balance skills.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量和随访时间未知，可能无法全面反映 AOT 的长期效果和在不同脑瘫亚型中的适用性。
items.limitationEn: The sample size and follow-up duration of the study are unknown, which may not fully reflect the long-term effects of AOT and its applicability across different CP subtypes.

items.title: Handgrip and leg strength and risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged ≥ 80 years: a prospective HUNT study
items.summary: A prospective HUNT study found that handgrip and leg strength are associated with the risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged ≥ 80 years, who experience the highest rates of fall-related injury and mortality.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 80 岁及以上老年人的前瞻性 HUNT 研究坐实了手握力和腿部力量与严重跌倒伤害的风险相关。在评估和预防老年人跌倒时，你应该将肌力评估作为核心环节，并将其纳入干预计划。
items.titleZh: 80 岁及以上成人手握力和腿部力量与严重跌倒伤害风险：一项前瞻性 HUNT 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性 HUNT 研究发现，手握力和腿部力量与 80 岁及以上成人严重跌倒伤害风险相关，该年龄组跌倒相关伤害和死亡率最高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective HUNT study on adults aged 80 years and above confirms the association between handgrip and leg strength and the risk of severe fall injuries. When assessing and preventing falls in older adults, you should consider muscle strength assessment as a core component and integrate it into intervention plans.
items.limitation: 研究的发现虽具有前瞻性，但其主要关注 80 岁以上人群，对外推到更年轻的老年群体可能需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: Although the study's findings are prospective, its primary focus on individuals aged 80 and above means generalization to younger elderly populations may require caution.

items.title: ACCESS (Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions) Model
items.summary: The U.S. CMS's ACCESS (Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions) Model is a 10-year innovation model for chronic care with rolling start dates, the next being August 17, 2026, and October 1, 2026.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 的 ACCESS 模型是一项针对慢性病护理的 10 年期创新模式，提供滚动启动日期，最近的启动日期是 2026 年 8 月 17 日和 10 月 1 日。你如果所在诊所或实践符合条件，可以考虑申请参与，这可能为慢性病患者提供新的护理和报销机会。
items.titleZh: ACCESS（通过有效、可扩展解决方案推进慢性病护理）模型 | CMS
items.summaryZh: 美国 CMS 的 ACCESS（通过有效、可扩展解决方案推进慢性病护理）模型是一项为期 10 年的慢性病护理创新模式，提供滚动启动日期，最近的启动日期为 2026 年 8 月 17 日和 2026 年 10 月 1 日。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS's ACCESS Model in the US is a 10-year innovation model for chronic care, offering rolling start dates, with the next ones on August 17, 2026, and October 1, 2026. If your clinic or practice is eligible, you might consider applying to participate, as this could open up new care and reimbursement opportunities for chronic disease patients.

items.title: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问-健康界
items.summary: China's "15th Five-Year Plan" for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) revitalization and development emphasizes enhancing TCM rehabilitation and nursing service capabilities, aiming to achieve universal access to TCM services and improve disease prevention and health promotion.
items.curatedReason: 《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》强调提升中医药康复护理服务能力。这表明中国将持续加大对中医药康复的支持，你应关注政策落地，探索中西医结合康复的新模式和新机遇。
items.titleZh: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问
items.summaryZh: 中国《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》强调提升中医药康复护理服务能力，旨在实现人人享有中医药服务，并加强疾病预防和健康促进。
items.curatedReasonEn: The "15th Five-Year Plan" for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) revitalization and development emphasizes enhancing TCM rehabilitation and nursing service capabilities. This indicates China will continue to increase support for TCM rehabilitation, and you should monitor policy implementation to explore new models and opportunities for integrated TCM and Western rehabilitation.

items.title: A randomized controlled trial of brachial plexus block manipulation versus steroid injection in conscious patients for moderate to severe shoulder stiffness
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial compared brachial plexus block manipulation versus steroid injection in conscious patients with moderate to severe shoulder stiffness.
items.curatedReason: 对于中度至重度肩关节僵硬患者，肱丛阻滞下手法松动术与类固醇注射都能提供有效缓解。在选择干预方案时，你需要权衡两种方案的疗效、潜在风险以及患者的具体情况。
items.titleZh: 清醒患者中肱丛阻滞手法松动术与类固醇注射治疗中重度肩关节僵硬的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验比较了在清醒患者中，肱丛阻滞手法松动术与类固醇注射治疗中重度肩关节僵硬的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For moderate to severe shoulder stiffness, both brachial plexus block manipulation and steroid injection offer effective relief. When choosing an intervention, you need to weigh the efficacy, potential risks, and specific patient circumstances for both options.
items.limitation: 这项研究的样本量和随访时间未知，需要更多信息来评估其长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The sample size and follow-up duration of this study are unknown, requiring more information to assess its long-term effects.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A research study investigated the diagnostic accuracy of Biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability, finding balance deficits well-documented but limited accuracy.
items.curatedReason: Biodex 平衡系统在慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者中诊断平衡缺陷时，尽管双任务条件下的表现可能更差，但其诊断准确性仍有限。在临床评估 CAI 时，不要过度依赖单一平衡系统指标，应结合多方面评估。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者单任务和双任务条件下 Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标的诊断准确性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了慢性踝关节不稳患者在单任务和双任务条件下 Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标的诊断准确性，发现平衡缺陷已有充分记录但准确性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: While Biodex balance system stability indices may show worse performance under dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability (CAI), their diagnostic accuracy remains limited. When clinically assessing CAI, avoid over-relying on single balance system metrics and incorporate multifaceted evaluations.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于慢性踝关节不稳患者，结果对外推到其他人群或急性损伤患者时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to individuals with chronic ankle instability, so caution is needed when generalizing results to other populations or acute injuries.

items.title: Bypass neural interfaces for paralysis: clinical translation, challenges and future directions | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A review explored the clinical translation, challenges, and future directions of bypass neural interfaces for paralysis, noting advances in neural recording, real-time decoding, and bioelectronic stimulation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述深入探讨了神经旁路接口在瘫痪患者中的临床转化、挑战和未来方向。它帮助你了解神经工程在康复领域的前沿进展，特别是对于重度瘫痪患者的潜在治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 瘫痪的神经旁路接口：临床转化、挑战与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 一篇综述探讨了瘫痪神经旁路接口的临床转化、挑战和未来方向，指出神经记录、实时解码和生物电子刺激方面的进展。
items.curatedReasonEn: Bypass neural interfaces show immense potential in the rehabilitation of paralyzed patients. Understanding these cutting-edge advancements in neuroengineering can broaden your perspective and allow you to offer more innovative treatment options for severely paralyzed individuals.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，其内容基于现有研究，可能包含不同证据质量的报告，且未提供新的原始数据。
items.limitationEn: As a review, its content is based on existing research, may include reports of varying evidence quality, and does not provide new original data.

items.title: Predictors of discharge destination of stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation center, including difficult discharge cases
items.summary: A research study identified predictors of discharge destination for stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation centers, including difficult discharge cases, noting that discharge destinations and delayed discharge incidence can substantially influence patient care and outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的出院去向和延迟出院的发生率，对患者的照护和预后有显著影响。你可以利用这些预测因素，更早地识别高风险患者，并进行干预，以优化出院规划，减少延迟出院。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者从住院康复中心出院去向的预测因素，包括难出院病例
items.summaryZh: 一项研究确定了卒中患者从住院康复中心出院去向的预测因素，包括难出院病例，指出出院去向和延迟出院的发生率会显著影响患者护理和预后。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke patients' discharge destinations and the incidence of delayed discharge significantly impact patient care and outcomes. You can use these predictive factors to identify high-risk patients earlier and intervene to optimize discharge planning, thereby reducing delayed discharges.
items.limitation: 研究可能存在地域和医疗系统特异性，其发现对外推到不同国家或医疗环境时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study may have regional and healthcare system specificities, and its findings should be generalized with caution to different countries or healthcare environments.

items.title: Survey of underlying risk factors and epidemiology of anterior knee pain in semi-professional male basketball players | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A research study surveyed underlying risk factors and epidemiology of anterior knee pain in semi-professional male basketball players, noting its high prevalence in jumping sports.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对半专业男篮球运动员的调查揭示了前膝痛的危险因素和流行病学。了解这些因素有助于你更好地识别高风险运动员，并制定有针对性的预防和干预策略。
items.titleZh: 半专业男篮球运动员前膝痛的潜在危险因素和流行病学调查
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了半专业男篮球运动员前膝痛的潜在危险因素和流行病学，指出其在跳跃运动中流行率很高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of semi-professional male basketball players revealed risk factors and epidemiology of anterior knee pain. Understanding these factors can help you better identify high-risk athletes and develop targeted prevention and intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性调查研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能仅适用于半专业男篮球运动员。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational survey study, which cannot establish causality, and the results may only apply to semi-professional male basketball players.

items.title: Distinct Movement-Related Cortical Control Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review aimed to synthesize evidence on cortical activity during motor tasks in ACL patients, noting distinct brain activity and limited comprehensive evidence on neural differences.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤后，患者在运动任务期间的皮质活动确实存在差异，但目前对其神经机制的全面证据仍然有限。在康复过程中，除了关注外周损伤，也应考虑到中枢神经系统的潜在适应和改变。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带损伤后独特的运动相关皮质控制：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述旨在综合 ACL 患者运动任务期间皮质活动的证据，指出独特的大脑活动以及神经差异方面的综合证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: After ACL injury, patients exhibit distinct cortical activity during motor tasks, but comprehensive evidence on the underlying neural differences remains limited. During rehabilitation, in addition to focusing on peripheral injury, consider the potential adaptations and changes in the central nervous system.
items.limitation: 作为一篇范围综述，它可能涵盖了各种研究设计和质量的证据，但本身不提供新的实验数据。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it may cover evidence of various study designs and quality, but it does not provide new experimental data itself.

items.title: Outcome indicators and effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes: a systematic review | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A systematic review evaluated outcome indicators and effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes, emphasizing its role in maintaining performance, enhancing recovery, and preventing injuries.
items.curatedReason: 营养教育在运动员维持表现、加速恢复和预防损伤方面发挥着关键作用。在你的运动康复实践中，考虑将营养教育整合进来，以提供更全面的服务。
items.titleZh: 运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述评估了运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性，强调其在维持表现、增强恢复和预防损伤中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Nutrition education plays a crucial role in athletes' performance maintenance, accelerated recovery, and injury prevention. In your sports rehabilitation practice, consider integrating nutrition education to provide more comprehensive services.
items.limitation: 尽管是系统综述，其结论的强度仍取决于纳入研究的质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, the strength of its conclusions still depends on the quality and heterogeneity of the included studies.

items.title: Biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy: a pilot study | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A pilot study investigated the biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy, which affects approximately 2 in 1000 people and can result in gait impairments.
items.curatedReason: 对于双瘫型脑瘫患者的步态障碍，动力式膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器可能提供生物力学上的改善。你可以将其作为潜在的辅助工具，但每个患者都需要个性化的评估和调整，才能发挥最大效果。
items.titleZh: 动力式膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器对双瘫型脑瘫患者的生物力学效应：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点研究调查了动力式膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器对双瘫型脑瘫患者的生物力学效应，指出该病影响约千分之二的人群，可导致步态障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: For gait impairments in individuals with diparetic cerebral palsy, powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses may offer biomechanical improvements. You can consider them as potential assistive tools, but each patient requires individualized assessment and adjustment to achieve maximum effectiveness.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量小，可能不足以得出广泛适用的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, which may be insufficient to draw broadly applicable conclusions.

items.title: Low-load blood flow restriction training vs high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults: a literature review
items.summary: A literature review compared low-load blood flow restriction training vs high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults, noting sarcopenia's significant health challenges in the aging population.
items.curatedReason: 对于无法承受高负荷阻力训练的老年肌少症患者，低负荷血流限制训练是一种值得考虑的替代方案，能达到类似的高负荷训练效果。
items.titleZh: 老年肌少症患者低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷阻力训练比较：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇文献综述比较了低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷阻力训练在老年肌少症患者中的效果，指出肌少症对老年人群带来了显著的健康挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with sarcopenia who cannot tolerate high-load resistance training, low-load blood flow restriction training is a viable alternative that can achieve similar benefits.
items.limitation: 作为一篇文献综述，其结论的强度取决于现有研究的质量和异质性，可能无法提供 Meta 分析级别的证据。
items.limitationEn: As a literature review, the strength of its conclusions depends on the quality and heterogeneity of existing studies, and it may not provide meta-analysis level evidence.

items.title: Associations of uric acid with wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics in older adults: vigor, symmetry, and stability
items.summary: A research study investigated the relationship between uric acid and wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics in 651 older adults (≥ 60 years), noting elevated uric acid has been linked to impaired nervous system and skeletal muscle function.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，尿酸水平可能与老年人的步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）相关。尽管是观察性研究，但它表明我们可以关注患者的尿酸水平，将其作为辅助评估步态功能和跌倒风险的潜在生物标志物。
items.titleZh: 老年人尿酸与可穿戴传感器数字步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了 651 名老年人（≥ 60 岁）尿酸与可穿戴传感器数字步态特征之间的关系，指出尿酸升高与神经系统和骨骼肌功能受损有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests a potential link between uric acid levels and gait characteristics (vigor, symmetry, and stability) in older adults. While observational, it indicates you might consider monitoring uric acid as a potential biomarker to aid in assessing gait function and fall risk.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，无法建立尿酸水平与步态特征之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study, which cannot establish a causal relationship between uric acid levels and gait characteristics.

items.title: Characterization of orthogeriatric care models and association with mortality and health-economic outcomes in patients with hip fractures: a retrospective cohort study from Germany
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study from Germany characterized orthogeriatric care models and their association with mortality and health-economic outcomes in patients with hip fractures.
items.curatedReason: 这项来自德国的回顾性队列研究描述了骨科老年护理模式的特征及其与髋部骨折患者死亡率和健康经济结局的关联。这为优化髋部骨折患者的康复路径和多学科护理提供了现实证据，你可以借鉴其经验。
items.titleZh: 骨科老年护理模式的特征及其与髋部骨折患者死亡率和健康经济结局的关联：一项德国回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项来自德国的回顾性队列研究，描述了骨科老年护理模式的特征及其与髋部骨折患者死亡率和健康经济结局的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cohort study from Germany characterized orthogeriatric care models and their association with mortality and health-economic outcomes in hip fracture patients. This provides real-world evidence for optimizing rehabilitation pathways and multidisciplinary care for hip fracture patients, which you can draw upon.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，且其结果可能具有德国医疗系统的特异性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to selection bias and confounding factors, and its results may be specific to the German healthcare system.

items.title: Frailty, physiological reserve, and surgical resilience: toward a dynamic stress–recovery model
items.summary: A commentary proposed a dynamic stress-recovery model for frailty, physiological reserve, and surgical resilience.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提出了衰弱、生理储备和手术复原力之间动态应激-恢复模型。这提醒你在围手术期康复中，需要更精细地评估老年患者的生理储备，并据此制定个性化的恢复计划。
items.titleZh: 衰弱、生理储备和手术复原力：迈向动态应激-恢复模型
items.summaryZh: 一篇述评提出了衰弱、生理储备和手术复原力之间的动态应激-恢复模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary proposes a dynamic stress-recovery model for frailty, physiological reserve, and surgical resilience. This reminds you that in perioperative rehabilitation, you need to more finely assess the physiological reserve of older patients and develop individualized recovery plans accordingly.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，主要基于专家意见和现有理论框架，缺乏新的实证数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary article, primarily based on expert opinions and existing theoretical frameworks, lacking new empirical data.

items.title: Long-term care insurance pilots and a severe care-gap proxy among older adults in China: evidence from CHARLS, 2011–2020
items.summary: A research study from China, using CHARLS 2011–2020 data, investigated whether long-term care insurance pilots reduced a severe care-gap proxy among older adults, noting limited evidence on policy rollout reducing care gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这项来自中国的观察性研究表明，长期护理保险试点项目可能有助于减少功能受限老年人的护理缺口。作为康复专业人员，了解并积极参与这些政策的实施，对改善老年患者的康复可及性和长期照护至关重要。
items.titleZh: 中国长期护理保险试点与老年人严重护理缺口：CHARLS 2011–2020 证据
items.summaryZh: 一项来自中国的研究，利用 CHARLS 2011-2020 数据，调查了长期护理保险试点项目是否减少了老年人严重的护理缺口，指出政策实施对减少护理缺口的影响证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study from China suggests that long-term care insurance pilot programs may help reduce care gaps for functionally limited older adults. As a rehab professional, understanding and actively engaging with these policy implementations is crucial for improving older patients' access to rehabilitation and long-term care.
items.limitation: 这是一项来自中国的研究，其政策背景和医疗系统特点可能限制了结果对外推到其他国家或地区。
items.limitationEn: This study from China, with its specific policy background and healthcare system, may have limited generalizability to other countries or regions.

items.title: Saratoga Physical Therapy Associates Increases Payment Per Visit by $5 using WebPT RCM
items.summary: Saratoga Physical Therapy Associates increased their payment per visit by $5 after implementing WebPT RCM, demonstrating the financial benefits of optimized revenue cycle management for physical therapy practices.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这个案例提示我们，RCM 优化能直接提升诊所营收。如果你还没细看过自家的每诊次支付额，现在是时候审视你的 RCM 流程了，别白白损失了这每诊次多出的几美元。
items.titleZh: Saratoga 物理治疗协会使用 WebPT RCM 后每诊次支付增加 5 美元
items.summaryZh: Saratoga 物理治疗协会在使用 WebPT 的收入周期管理（RCM）系统后，成功将其每诊次的支付额提高了 5 美元。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT case study suggests that RCM optimization can directly boost clinic revenue. If you haven't recently scrutinized your payment per visit, it's time to audit your RCM processes; don't leave those extra few dollars per visit on the table.

items.title: Safety of Early Rehabilitation Dose After Stroke on Composite Outcomes: Analysis of Nationwide Japanese Medical Claims Data.
items.summary: This study analyzed Japanese medical claims data from 2018-2022 to evaluate the safety of early in-hospital rehabilitation (20-60 min/day initiated on days 1 or 2) after stroke in patients aged ≥ 18 years, finding no increased risk of adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 这项日本大型索赔数据分析提示，卒中后 1-2 天内早期康复是安全的，并无额外不良事件风险。你可以放心地在卒中急性期早期介入，无需担忧安全性问题。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期康复剂量对复合结局的安全性的分析：日本全国医疗索赔数据。
items.summaryZh: 这项基于 2018-2022 年日本医疗索赔数据的大型观察研究评估了卒中后早期（1-2 天内开始，20-60 分钟/天）院内康复的安全性，发现其并无额外不良事件风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large Japanese claims data analysis suggests that early rehabilitation within 1-2 days post-stroke is safe, with no additional risk of adverse events. You can confidently intervene in the acute phase of stroke without safety concerns.
items.limitation: 本研究基于日本医保索赔数据，可能存在混杂因素，且结局指标仅限于安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study, based on Japanese medical claims data, may be subject to confounding factors, and the outcome measures were limited to safety.

items.title: Beyond "Biomedical-Plus": Reclaiming the biopsychosocial model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: The biopsychosocial (BPS) model is often reduced to "biomedical-plus" in MSK physiotherapy. This article argues for a more authentic BPS application through professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒我们，生物心理社会（BPS）模型在肌骨物理治疗中常被简化为“生物医学附加”，削弱了其整合性。要真正实践 BPS，你需要关注专业信心、角色清晰和富有同情心的沟通这三个关键要素。
items.titleZh: 超越“生物医学附加”：在肌骨物理治疗中回归生物心理社会模型
items.summaryZh: 生物心理社会（BPS）模型在肌骨物理治疗中常被简化为“生物医学附加”护理。本文倡导通过专业信心、角色清晰和富有同情心的沟通（3Cs）实现更真实的 BPS 应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds us that the biopsychosocial (BPS) model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy is often reduced to "biomedical-plus," undermining its integrative potential. To truly implement BPS, you need to focus on professional confidence, role clarity, and compassionate communication.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未提供量化证据支持其提出的模型和建议。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review that does not provide quantitative evidence to support its proposed model and recommendations.

items.title: Effectiveness of Combined Biopsychosocial Interventions for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found combined biopsychosocial interventions significantly reduce pain and functional disability in adults with chronic low back pain (≥12 weeks) compared to usual care or unimodal interventions.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性腰痛（≥12周）患者，你应优先选择生物心理社会综合干预。这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析证实，这类整合了运动、疼痛教育和心理策略的方案，能显著减轻患者疼痛并改善功能。
items.titleZh: 联合生物心理社会干预对慢性腰痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与常规护理或单一干预相比，结合生物心理社会干预能显著减轻慢性腰痛（≥12 周）成年人的疼痛和功能残疾。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain (≥12 weeks) patients, prioritize combined biopsychosocial interventions. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that integrated approaches, including exercise, pain education, and psychological strategies, significantly reduce pain and improve functional disability.
items.limitation: 该综述未报告纳入研究中是否存在显著异质性。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report whether significant heterogeneity was present among the included studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Outpatient rehabilitation can prevent suicide after acquired brain injury.
items.summary: A registry study (n=591 treated patients, n=2,932 controls) suggests that outpatient rehabilitation may prevent suicide after acquired brain injury, with a higher suicide frequency found in general population post-stroke and TBI.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出，门诊康复可能降低获得性脑损伤患者的自杀风险。这强化了康复医学在精神健康支持方面的作用，你需要认识到康复计划不仅关注身体功能，也对患者的心理健康有重要保护作用。
items.titleZh: 门诊康复可以预防获得性脑损伤后的自杀
items.summaryZh: 一项注册研究（n=591 名治疗患者，n=2,932 名对照）表明，门诊康复可能预防获得性脑损伤后的自杀，卒中和创伤性脑损伤后人群的自杀频率高于一般人群。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that outpatient rehabilitation may reduce the risk of suicide in patients with acquired brain injury. This reinforces the role of rehabilitation medicine in mental health support, and you need to recognize that rehabilitation programs not only focus on physical function but also have an important protective effect on patients' mental health.
items.limitation: 本研究为注册表研究，可能存在混杂因素，且未报告干预的具体内容。
items.limitationEn: This is a registry study, which may have confounders and did not report specific intervention content.

items.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological study (n=94 telehealth equity trials) assessed equity in physiotherapy telehealth interventions using the PROGRESS Plus framework, identifying gaps in reaching vulnerable populations.
items.curatedReason: 你的远程医疗服务真的公平吗？这项荟萃流行病学研究（n=94项试验）指出，当前物理治疗远程医疗在覆盖弱势群体方面仍有明显不足。推广远程医疗时，请务必关注如何缩小数字鸿沟，确保服务均等可及。
items.titleZh: 探索物理治疗远程医疗干预中的公平性：一项荟萃流行病学研究
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃流行病学研究（n=94 项远程医疗公平性试验）利用 PROGRESS Plus 框架评估了物理治疗远程医疗干预中的公平性，识别了在覆盖弱势群体方面的差距。
items.curatedReasonEn: Is your telehealth service truly equitable? This meta-epidemiological study (n=94 trials) indicates that current physiotherapy telehealth significantly underperforms in reaching vulnerable populations. When expanding telehealth, you must prioritize bridging the digital divide to ensure equitable access.
items.limitation: 本研究为荟萃流行病学研究，其结果依赖于纳入 RCT 的报告质量。
items.limitationEn: This meta-epidemiological study's results depend on the reporting quality of the included RCTs.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: Spine-related leg pain (SRLP) is a common and debilitating condition. This review clarifies SRLP terminology, distinguishing radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain, aiming to reduce diagnostic uncertainty and improve management.
items.curatedReason: 本综述明确了脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的术语、病因和临床表现，能帮你更精准地诊断和管理。特别是 IASP 对根性痛、神经根病和躯体转诊痛的区分，是临床实践的重要参考，减少诊断不确定性。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）是一种常见且致残的疾病。本综述旨在澄清 SRLP 的术语，区分神经根病、根性痛和躯体转诊痛，以减少诊断不确定性并改善管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies the terminology, etiology, and clinical presentation of spine-related leg pain (SRLP), which helps you in more precise diagnosis and management. The IASP distinction among radicular pain, radiculopathy, and somatic referred pain is a crucial reference for clinical practice, reducing diagnostic uncertainty.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚且未进行定量分析。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, this study may be subject to selection bias and lacks quantitative analysis.

items.title: Digital Addiction and Body Balance: An Investigation of Postural Stability in Young Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study (n=74) found young adults with smartphone addiction exhibited impaired postural stability, particularly under attention-demanding tasks, highlighting the impact of digital device use on balance.
items.curatedReason: 研究发现数字成瘾与年轻人姿势平衡下降有关。在评估年轻患者的姿势稳定性时，你应考虑他们的数字设备使用习惯，这可能是潜在的干预点。
items.titleZh: 数字成瘾与身体平衡：一项针对年轻人的姿势稳定性调查：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究（n=74）发现，有智能手机成瘾的年轻人在姿势稳定性方面表现出受损，尤其是在需要注意力分散的任务下，这突出显示了数字设备使用对平衡的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that digital addiction is associated with decreased postural balance in young adults. When assessing postural stability in young patients, you should consider their digital device usage habits, as this could be a potential intervention point.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which prevents establishing causality.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Assessment and Management Practices for Post-Stroke Shoulder Pain Among Rehabilitation Professionals in Vietnam: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey in Vietnam investigated rehabilitation professionals' practices for post-stroke shoulder pain, identifying potential gaps between evidence and clinical application, particularly in lower- and middle-income countries.
items.curatedReason: 这项调查揭示了越南卒中后肩痛评估和管理实践的现状。它提醒你，临床实践在全球范围内存在差异，即使有循证指南，在资源有限地区仍可能存在证据与实践之间的差距。
items.titleZh: 越南康复专业人员卒中后肩痛评估与管理实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项在越南进行的横断面调查研究了康复专业人员对卒中后肩痛的评估和管理实践，旨在识别证据与临床应用之间的潜在差距，尤其是在中低收入国家。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey reveals the current state of assessment and management practices for post-stroke shoulder pain in Vietnam. It reminds you that clinical practice varies globally, and even with evidence-based guidelines, gaps between evidence and practice can persist in resource-limited regions.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映了特定地区康复专业人员的自我报告实践。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, reflecting self-reported practices of rehabilitation professionals in a specific region.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes advances in spinal connectomics, highlighting the spinal cord's role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control, moving beyond its traditional perception as a simple reflex relay.
items.curatedReason: 别再把脊髓只看作简单的反射中继站了。这篇综述指出，脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中扮演着更主动的角色，这对于理解复杂脊髓损伤患者的恢复潜力至关重要。
items.titleZh: 通过机器学习和神经工程学推进脊柱连接组学和神经整合：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述总结了脊柱连接组学的进展，强调脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的作用，超越了其作为简单反射中继的传统认知。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stop viewing the spinal cord as just a simple reflex relay. This review highlights its more active role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control, which is crucial for understanding recovery potential in complex spinal cord injury patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未能提供定量证据或具体临床实践建议。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review does not provide quantitative evidence or specific clinical practice recommendations.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: The Combined Use of Non-Invasive Neurostimulation with Interactive Digital Technologies in Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review maps empirical evidence for the combined use of non-invasive neurostimulation with interactive digital technologies in spinal cord injury rehabilitation, identifying 494 unique records.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述梳理了非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术在脊髓损伤康复中结合使用的证据。你可以了解现有研究的广度和局限性，为未来将这些技术整合到脊髓损伤患者的治疗方案中提供初步依据。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术在脊髓损伤康复中的联合应用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 本范围综述梳理了非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术在脊髓损伤康复中联合使用的实证证据，共识别出 494 条独立记录。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review maps the empirical evidence for combining non-invasive neurostimulation with interactive digital technologies in spinal cord injury rehabilitation. You can understand the breadth and limitations of existing research, providing preliminary grounds for integrating these technologies into treatment plans for spinal cord injury patients in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未对纳入研究的证据质量进行严格评估或进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review did not rigorously assess the quality of evidence of included studies or conduct a meta-analysis.

items.title: Effects of multimodal balance training with and without auditory cues on balance, gait mobility, risk of fall and quality of life in patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: This RCT (n=42 chronic stroke survivors) found multimodal balance training, with or without auditory cues, improved balance, gait mobility, fall risk, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，多模式平衡训练（无论是否带有听觉提示）对慢性卒中患者的平衡、步态、跌倒风险和生活质量均有益。在你的临床实践中，可以考虑将这类训练方案纳入慢性卒中康复计划。
items.titleZh: 多模式平衡训练联合或不联合听觉提示对慢性卒中患者平衡、步态移动性、跌倒风险和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=42 名慢性卒中幸存者）发现，多模式平衡训练（无论是否联合听觉提示）在 12 周内改善了慢性卒中患者的平衡、步态移动性、跌倒风险和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial indicates that multimodal balance training (with or without auditory cues) benefits balance, gait, fall risk, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients. In your clinical practice, you may consider incorporating such training protocols into chronic stroke rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（42 名患者），结果的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (42 patients), which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated factors beyond motor impairment, such as proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy, that explain limited daily hand-use in individuals post-stroke with fair-to-good motor ability.
items.curatedReason: 即使卒中患者手部运动能力尚可，日常使用却可能受限。这项观察研究提示我们，在康复评估中，你除了关注运动功能，还必须考虑本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等非运动因素，这些才是影响实际手部功能的关键。
items.titleZh: 解释卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的因素
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的非运动因素，包括本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even with fair-to-good motor ability post-stroke, daily hand-use can be limited. This observational study suggests that beyond motor function, you must consider non-motor factors like proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy in rehabilitation assessments, as these are crucial for actual hand function.

items.title: Lifestyle medicine innovations: Physical activity assessment in patient care and implementation of a digital health platform to support healthier movement.
items.summary: This narrative review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform, a scalable approach for integrating personalized physical activity and home exercise into clinical care across diverse patient populations.
items.curatedReason: 文章介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台及其在将体力活动作为临床护理一部分的潜力。你可以了解这类数字工具如何帮助患者进行个性化体力活动和家庭锻炼，是远程康复和健康管理的新方向。
items.titleZh: 生活方式医学创新：患者护理中的体力活动评估与数字健康平台实施以支持更健康的运动
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台，这是一种将个性化体力活动和家庭锻炼整合到不同患者群体的临床护理中的可扩展方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform and its potential to integrate physical activity into clinical care. You can learn how such digital tools can help patients with personalized physical activity and home exercise, representing a new direction for telerehabilitation and health management.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，缺乏实证数据支持其宣称的平台效果。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review lacks empirical data to support the claimed effectiveness of the platform.
